description: Estimate nutrition for one recipe the user can see, per serving and total, from USDA data. Read-only. Tell the user it is an estimate and mention unmatched ingredients. Returns {recipe, servings, per_serving:{calories, protein_g, fat_g, carbs_g, ...}, total, matched, unmatched}.

id.description: Recipe id (UUID) from search_recipes or an earlier result

servings.description: Report for the recipe scaled to this many servings; default its own servings

name: get_nutrition
title: Recipe nutrition
